issue.title: Tune the install_ui ETA dispersion gate and percentile pair after a week of real runs.jsonl history
issue.description:
From the epic bob-cli-i0 plan (plan:202611/install_all_wait_and_whats_new.md, docs-acceptance
phase bob-cli-i0.7, follow-up item 4c). bob-cli-i0.7 recorded follow-ups (a) and (b) but not this one;
the epic's land agent filed it.

scripts/lib/install_ui/estimate.py earns an ETA range only after RANGE_SAMPLES=5 matching runs
whose per-phase p80/p20 ratio is <= DISPERSION=1.6 (phases with p80 >= 10 s), and shows the
p20-p80 span as "about N-M min left"; the bar anchors to the sum of p80 and overtime starts there.
These constants were chosen without real data.

After about a week of real history on the Mac (runs.jsonl under
~/.local/state/bob-cli/install-all/, from about 2026-11-13), analyze the bob-cli and
bob-mac-capture rows: how often the range rung applies, how often actual durations land inside
the shown span, how often "taking longer than usual" fires, and how the A5 quick filter behaves.
Tune DISPERSION, the percentile pair, and RANGE_SAMPLES if the data says so, updating
scripts/lib/install_ui/tests/test_estimate.py tables.

task_type_fields.proposal: Analyze about a week of Mac runs.jsonl history and tune DISPERSION, the p20/p80 percentile pair, and RANGE_SAMPLES in scripts/lib/install_ui/estimate.py, with updated estimator test tables.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Tuning needs real per-host build history that only accumulates after epic bob-cli-i0 lands, so it cannot be part of the epic itself.

issue.creation_reason: The install-all ETA estimator's 1.6 dispersion gate, p20/p80 span, and 5-sample threshold were picked without data; the epic plan scheduled a tuning pass once history exists, but its docs phase never recorded it.

snooze.reason: Needs about a week of real runs.jsonl history after epic bob-cli-i0 lands
